title.en: An Act Defining Fraudulent Enlistment in the Philippines Constabulary, and Providing the Punishment therefor.
title.orig: An Act Defining Fraudulent Enlistment in the Philippines Constabulary, and Providing the Punishment therefor.

text.en:
It shall be unlawful for any person to enlist in the Philippines Constabulary under an assumed
name, or upon enlistment therein to make any willfully and intentionally false representation as to his
nationality, age, parents, or guardian.

It shall be unlawful for any person who has been dishonorably discharged from the military or
naval service of the United States, or from the Philippines Constabulary, to enlist or reenlist in said
Philippines Constabulary.

Any person who shall violate any provision of this Act shall be guilty of fraudulent enlistment
and, upon conviction thereof by a court of competent jurisdiction, shall be punished by imprisonment for a
term not exceeding six months, or by a fine not exceeding five hundred pesos, or by both such imprisonment
and fine, in the discretion of the court..

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 14, 1909.
